value.rationale: The first square, nontrivial three-firm market with two empirically meaningful worker-firm quality levels is a natural structural subdomain. The theorem completes its exact EF1 versus transferable stability frontier for every quality ratio and identifies maximum-high-edge-matching size as a complete constructive classification, including the (1/2,1) region not closed by the unrestricted motivating theorem. An attained adversarial value and explicit wages are informative for team design. It claims no unrestricted improvement or paper-scale result.
